assumptions.rationale: Values are illustrative only. They model a traffic-operations scenario where correctly identifying high-traffic periods has higher value, while false alerts and missed high-traffic periods both carry practical cost.
assumptions.unit: relative decision-value points per held-out traffic record

limitations: The values are simulated and are not real business figures.
A real deployment would need domain-calibrated costs, intervention capacity, and risk review.
The analysis uses a held-out public dataset split rather than production outcomes.
practical_value: Positive simulated value indicates that the model could support prioritised traffic review under the stated assumptions.
use_case: Demonstration of how a traffic-operations team could triage likely high-volume periods for extra monitoring using model predictions.
